blocks.text: A "wall" organizer designed to hold various household objects with handles of varying thickness. Simply insert a handle into a slot and a rounded, gravity controlled, rolling ball automatically adjusts to the handle's thickness and grips it securely. Use in the laundry, garage, garden, utility room, offices, and more. Plastic Mop, Broom, and Long-Handled Tool or Sports Equipment Holder System-Mount on the Wall in Your Home's Kitchen or Garage - Hang Items Securely- Great Storage Idea for Staying Organized-Best Lifetime Guarantee. items: Versatile Broom Holder Wall Mount - Keep your cleaning tools neatly stored and accessible with this mop and broom holder! It also works great as a garage organization and garden tool storage solution.
Easy To Mount Garage Storage Solutions - Included with the garage organizers are screws, anchors, a drilling template, and a guide–everything you'll need to mount this mop hanger indoors or outdoors!
Durable Garage Shelving - Our broom and mop storage rack can hold up to 11 tools and every slot can support up to 7.5lbs. Our garage storage racks have a total load-bearing capacity of 38lbs.

Secure & Easy To Use Garden Tool Rack - The 5 slots have an easy-release design for quick retrieval. They're non-slip, have soft rubber grids, and are strong enough to hold wet mops and baseball bats.

Organize Your Space - Aside from cleaning tools, our mop holder wall mount can also hold everyday household items. Free up floor space in your home by hanging up your umbrellas, shopping bags, or coats!
